title: GL-02 — Private S3 data controls
stopChargesPanel: Empty the bucket (all versions), delete lifecycle, policy, and bucket when finished. Versioned objects must be removed before delete-bucket.

steps.title: Set the profile and region
bullets: In PowerShell run `$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'your-lab-profile'` using a named profile, not root.
Run `$env:AWS_REGION = 'us-east-1'`.
Success: both variables print the expected values.

steps.title: Confirm who is signed in
bullets: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity`.
Success: Arn contains `:user/` or `:assumed-role/`, not `:root`.
Set `$AccountId` from the Account field.

steps.title: Confirm AWS CLI v2
bullets: Run `aws --version`.
Success: output starts with `aws-cli/2`.
This lab focuses on S3 data controls; Terraform is not required unless a step says so.

steps.title: Read the cost estimate
bullets: Open this lab's same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates in the card header.
Success: you can state both numbers before creating billable resources.
Budget alerts from GL-01 warn only; they do not stop spend.

steps.title: Set lab variables
bullets: Set `$CreatedAt` and `$ExpiresAt` to today's calendar date.
Set `$Bucket = "workbook-gl02-$AccountId"`. Names must be globally unique and lowercase.
Success: date variables and lab names are set.

steps.title: Create the private bucket
bullets: Run `aws s3api create-bucket --bucket $Bucket --region us-east-1 --tagging "TagSet=[{Key=Workbook,Value=aws-tf-lab},{Key=LabId,Value=gl-02},{Key=CreatedAt,Value=$CreatedAt},{Key=ExpiresAt,Value=$ExpiresAt}]"`.
In us-east-1 do not pass LocationConstraint.
Success: `aws s3api head-bucket --bucket $Bucket` exits 0.

steps.title: Block all public access
bullets: Run `aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket $Bucket --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true`.
Success: all four flags are true.

steps.title: Enable versioning and lifecycle
bullets: Run `aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket $Bucket --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled`.
Save lifecycle.json with one rule Expiration Days=1 on prefix `lab/` and Status Enabled.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\lifecycle.json", '{"Rules":[{"ID":"gl02-lab-expire","Filter":{"Prefix":"lab/"},"Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":1}}]}', $utf8)`.
Run `aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket $Bucket --lifecycle-configuration file://lifecycle.json`.
Success: versioning shows Enabled.

steps.title: Upload a tiny object
bullets: Run `'hello-gl02' | Out-File -Encoding ascii gl02.txt`.
Run `aws s3 cp gl02.txt s3://$Bucket/lab/gl02.txt`.
Success: head-object returns ContentLength.

steps.title: Attach a bucket policy requiring TLS
bullets: Save gl02-policy.json denying s3:PutObject unless aws:SecureTransport is true for bucket $Bucket.

Run `$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; $Gl02Policy = @{ Version = '2012-10-17'; Statement = @(@{ Sid = 'DenyInsecureTransport'; Effect = 'Deny'; Principal = '*'; Action = 's3:PutObject'; Resource = "arn:aws:s3:::$Bucket/*"; Condition = @{ Bool = @{ 'aws:SecureTransport' = 'false' } } }) }; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$pwd\gl02-policy.json", ($Gl02Policy | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress), $utf8)`.
Run `aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket $Bucket --policy file://gl02-policy.json`.
Success: get-bucket-policy returns your document.

steps.title: Validate HTTPS copy
bullets: Run `aws s3 cp gl02.txt s3://$Bucket/lab/gl02-copy.txt`.
Success: copy succeeds over HTTPS.

steps.title: Cost checkpoint
bullets: Re-read the same-hour and forgotten-24h estimates on this lab card.
S3 bills storage per GB-month and PUT/GET requests per request; nothing in this lab is hourly, and there is no instance to stop.
Success: you know what still bills if you walk away overnight.

steps.title: Order the deletes
bullets: Teardown order for this lab: empty versioned objects and delete markers, bucket policy, lifecycle, then delete-bucket
Open Stop charges and read each PowerShell line top to bottom.
Success: dependents are deleted before parents.

steps.title: Tear the lab down
bullets: Run every Stop charges command yourself in order.
Success: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-02` returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList.

steps.title: Check the bill later
bullets: After 8–12 hours, review today's charges in the Billing console.
Record actual spend in your notes.
Leftover tagged resources can still bill until deleted.

hints: Use official AWS docs for exact flags.

verification: aws s3api head-bucket --bucket $Bucket returns 404 Not Found
aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-02 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=gl-02 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=gl-02. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

body: Create one private S3 bucket with block public access, versioning, a one-day lifecycle on prefix lab/, a tiny object, and a bucket policy requiring TLS. Same-hour cost is pennies for storage requests.
